description: Getting found: ground-to-air visual code and body signals, 406 MHz beacons (PLB, EPIRB, ELT) and avoiding false alerts, flares, smoke, distress flag and SOS lights, VHF MAYDAY and DSC distress calls, and the SKYWARN spotter network.
